2609.21672.title: Accelerating Dense LLMs via L0-regularized Mixture-of-Experts
2609.21672.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance but suffer from slow and costly inference. Existing acceleration methods often lead to noticeable performance degradation, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models require extensive computational resources. In this paper, we propose L0-MoE, a lightweight MoE approach using L0-regularization to accelerate dense LLMs nearly without performance loss. Our method introduces a cluster confusion matrix for domain-aware dataset curation and applies dynamic batching for efficient training. Experiments show that L0-MoE achieves up to 2.5x speedup over dense models while maintaining competitive performance, outperforming existing LLM acceleration baselines.
2609.21672.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）表現優異，但推理速度慢且成本高昂。現有的加速方法往往會導致明顯的性能下降，而專家混合（MoE）模型則需要大量的計算資源。在本文中，我們提出了L0-MoE，一種輕量級的MoE方法，利用L0正則化來加速密集型LLMs，幾乎不會損失性能。我們的方法引入了一個集群混淆矩陣，用於領域感知的數據集策劃，並應用動態批處理以提高訓練效率。實驗表明，L0-MoE在保持競爭性能的同時，實現了比密集模型高達2.5倍的加速，超越了現有的LLM加速基準。
